verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms docs.openhands.dev serves a populated llms.txt file explicitly described as an 'LLM-friendly index of OpenHands documentation,' and the docs also expose a machine-readable openapi.json, both of which let an AI agent consume agent-oriented documentation directly. Missing for 10: no independent/community confirmation that agents actually use these successfully, and no explicit mention of an agents.md or similar secondary agent-oriented doc format.
